alkove.title: Alkove
alkove.text: Listens to one voice, answers to any name. Voice isolation, wake words, voice activity and voiceprints, no server.

assistant.title: AI assistant
assistant.text: Reads people's documents and messages, acts on them, and runs the support desk before a human steps in.

brindille.title: Brindille
brindille.text: French text-to-speech in your browser. 93,734 parameters, 2.7 MB with its engine.

spascii.title: Spascii
spascii.text: A slow space game drawn in ASCII. You talk to the crew in your own words, and a small embedding model in your browser understands you. No LLM.

redteam.title: agent-redteam
redteam.text: Test your own AI agent before someone else does: injection, tool abuse, data leaks. Ends with a report and a regression pack.

article.title: Can a plain table hijack an AI agent?
article.text: Hardened models flagged every instruction I hid in a tool result. A plain table with no instruction in it got all three.
